column_naming_convention: snake_case (janitor::clean_names applied to raw NHANES SAS names)

lod_code_semantics.0: at or above LOD; reported value is the measured concentration
lod_code_semantics.1: below LOD; reported value is imputed by NHANES at LOD / sqrt(2)

matrix_isolation.rationale: Each matrix carries its own analytical method, unit system, sampling frame, and regulatory framing. Cross-matrix combination requires an explicit harmonization artifact and is not authorized by this contract.
matrix_isolation.enforcement: Lane ingestion code MUST reject any input row that simultaneously carries a serum analyte value and a column from any environmental matrix in the must_not_be_combined_with list.

refusal_conditions: Input not derived from human serum biomonitoring
Cycle / population beyond NHANES J coverage without paired harmonization artifact
Concentration outside the observed envelope by more than 3 sigma without batch metadata
Units other than ng/mL without explicit conversion

out_of_scope_versions.P_PFAS_prepandemic_2017_2020: Requires serum_v1.1 or serum_v2; not covered by v1.0.
out_of_scope_versions.L06AGE_C_2003_2004_legacy: Requires serum_v1.1 or serum_v2; not covered by v1.0.

PFAS_H_2013_2014.label_unit_caveat: CDC SAS labels say '(ug/L)' but the codebook's LLOD table is explicitly in ng/mL. 1 ug/L equals 1 ng/mL in aqueous matrix (serum density ~1.025 g/mL); the numbers are equivalent within ~2.5 percent, but any future admission MUST reconcile the label-unit mismatch in the ingestion pipeline.
PFAS_H_2013_2014.isomer_split_caveat: PFAS_H lacks the n-/Sb- PFOA and n-/Sm- PFOS isomer split that v1.0 carries (LBXNFOA, LBXBFOA, LBXNFOS, LBXMFOS). The isomer-resolved companion file SSPFAS_H is itself out of scope (see below).
PFAS_H_2013_2014.status: NOT in v1.0; now governed as a peer lane under validation/serum_h_v1/ (anchor CSV SHA-256 98d11b27beadad159a9bb596caa2e8839b5bfca279fd32f618e60539c53f644f). Cycle H is still out of scope for v1.0; cross-cycle merging requires a documented harmonization artifact.

SSPFAS_H_2013_2014.role: Surplus-serum companion file carrying the n-/Sb- PFOA and n-/Sm- PFOS isomer split for NHANES 2013-2014. Must be paired with PFAS_H_2013_2014, not merged directly into the v1.0 panel.
SSPFAS_H_2013_2014.status: NOT in v1.0; also NOT admitted under serum_h_v1. Recorded by SHA-256 1e23688dfa6bdfdc14c0447f4d34032983271063a1a343c04338ae4258515c99 in validation/serum_h_v1/provenance.md §3.1. Admission requires a follow-up artifact paired with serum_h_v1.

physiological_classification.scope: lane-specific; this stamp applies only to the serum lane (schema_contract.md §9.3) and MUST NOT be borrowed by environmental or reference-material lanes

field_notes.source_program: Source-program coordinate (issuing agency + dataset family). The specific NHANES cycle is captured by `source_dataset` in the canonical core (e.g. 'NHANES PFAS (2017-2020 P_PFAS)'), not duplicated here.
field_notes.governance_lane: The (pipeline_id, governance_version) coordinate that points back to this lane's governance bundle (validation/serum_v1/). Machine-checkable join key between a row in the training table and the contract under which it was admitted.
field_notes.units_excluded: Concentration units are a row property, not a lane property. The canonical core already records them per row in `result_unit` (ng/mL for NHANES, ug/kg for NIST SRM 1957). Duplicating them as a lane-stamped constant created two sources of truth that disagreed on SRM rows.

guard.enforcement_layer: row-level (validate / normalize / save / train must all call the physiological guard before admitting a row to the serum lane)

anchor_invariant.stamp_location_at_rest: The five stamp columns are appended to the DERIVED training table (data/training/serum/training.csv), NEVER to the anchor CSV above. Modifying the anchor would change its SHA-256 and break the promotion gate in schema_contract.md §8.
